name: Vermont
short: Efficiency Vermont pays up to $475 for a ductless heat pump and up to $2,200 for a ducted one, with an income bonus of $200 to $2,200. Green Mountain Power adds $2,000 for households at or below 80% of area median income. A heat pump water heater gets $600, and home weatherization gets up to $4,000, or $9,500 for moderate-income homes. The federal tax credits ended on December 31, 2025.
